$comment: Stage 0 rule set: one governed doc type, 3 to 5 patterns, a short banned-word list.
Copy it next to the corpus's vocabulary.json (the vocabulary layer) and replace every "Replace with" line with real sentences from the doc type that caused the trouble.
Every key, and the optional ones a stage allows: references/statements/patterns.md.
Check: python3 scripts/lint_cnl.py rules.json vocabulary.json <governed docs>

docTypes.description: Replace with the doc type that caused errors or ambiguity, and who reads it.

bannedWords.fix: Write "shall" for a requirement; move a wish or rationale out of the requirement.
Name the condition or the value.
Write "and" or "or", or split the statement.
State a measurable limit, for example "within 2 seconds".
State the observable behavior a reader can test.
